runner: run_lerobot_libero.py (LeRobot policy, processors, LIBERO env and rollout loop)
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: LeRobot port (lerobot org) of FastWAM, run as the reproduce command of LeRobot's fastwam docs: n_action_steps 10 (chunk 32), 256 px observations, step limits 300 (spatial/object/goal) and 600 (libero_10), toggle_action_dimensions [-1] from the checkpoint. Differences: bfloat16 (the checkpoint's torch_dtype) instead of the docs' float32, which does not fit a 32 GB GPU; seed 1000+init instead of 0. The docs report 97.6/99.0/95.0/94.0. The original FastWAM evaluation (yuantianyuan01/FastWAM) uses 30 no-op steps and 400/700 steps. Wan2.2 VAE, UMT5-XXL encoder and tokenizer read from local copies of Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers and google/umt5-xxl.
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
